hints.title: Digit DP State Formulation
hints.text: Count balanced integers <= N using digit state tracking tracking position, difference between even and odd sums, and tight constraint.

hints.title: Prefix Subtraction
hints.text: Answer for range [low, high] equals count(high) - count(low - 1).

hints.title: Alternating Parity Sign
hints.text: In each step, add digit to difference if position is even, subtract if odd. Valid numbers have final difference 0.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here L is the number of digits and D is the maximum digit sum difference.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating every number in range takes up to O(high - low) time which is prohibitive.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Digit DP memoization table uses O(L * D) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects standard digit DP with tight bounds and leading zero handling.
